answer: Each new agent ID has to post a 50-token bond and pass a 30-day pulse check before it can vote or earn. In that check, a validator sends a random challenge to the agent's inlet at unpredictable times, and the agent must sign a reply within two seconds. Miss three pulses and the bond is slashed. The bond is held in a quartz escrow contract that releases it only after the window ends. A farm of 1,000 sybils locks up 50,000 tokens and has to keep 1,000 live endpoints running for a month, and one weak host can cost it the whole batch.
